_readme: THE MASTER RATING FLOW — authored once, cloned per shop by deploy/seed/bootstrap-rating-flow.py
this file is the flow_json source, sent exactly once, on the platform's own WABA).
ONE SCREEN, TERMINAL. A star pick (RadioButtonsGroup, 1-5) and an optional free-text comment
(TextArea), submitted once via the Footer's `complete` action — no endpoint_uri, no second
screen, no back-and-forth: `complete` terminates the Flow and hands the payload straight to
the completion message on the chat thread, which is what services/reminders' rating-reply
KEY NAMES ARE THE CONTRACT. `flow_token`, `stars` and `comment` are the exact keys the parser
reads (per the Phase-3 spec) — do not rename them here without renaming them there.
static, endpoint-less Flow needs only `version` and `screens`; RadioButtonsGroup/TextArea
must sit inside a `Form` (pre-4.0 rule, still valid at the pinned version below); the
terminal action is `{"name": "complete", "payload": {...}}", which needs no endpoint_uri.
